title.narrative: UNICEF played a pivotal role in advancing Cambodia&39;s Decentralization and Deconcentration (D&D) reform by introducing innovative sub-national approaches that strengthened governance and capacity at the local level. This contributed to more integrated and effective budgeting processes, enabling the efficient delivery of high-quality social services and social protection while institutionalizing robust social accountability and feedback mechanisms.
